items.headline: NFL Referees Association to challenge officials' suspensions
items.description: The NFL Referees Association said it will challenge the severity of the suspensions of two officials for unprofessional conduct.

items.headline: Cardinals LT Paris Johnson out for season after tearing biceps
items.description: Cardinals starting left tackle Paris Johnson Jr. is out for the season after tearing his left biceps in a 36-24 loss to the New York Giants on Sunday.

items.headline: NFL suspends officials Jeff Seeman, Adrian Hill for conduct toward players
items.description: The NFL has suspended line judge Jeff Seeman for two games for appearing to swear at Cardinals tight end Trey McBride. Referee Adrian Hill has been suspended one game for a separate incident in the Vikings' win over the Dolphins.
